text:
People Ops: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A thread about reviews, leveling, promos, comp & benefits. Drop short questions and we'll answer here. :wave:

Sam K: When will final manager write-ups be visible in the review tool?

People Ops: Managers must finalize by Tue 5pm PT. Lattice unlocks view within 24h of submission. Ping us if it doesn't appear.

Aisha L: Promo question: someone hit the bar in May. If manager requests a June effective date, is pay adjusted immediately?

CompBot: Promo policy: effective date = requested date (within quarter). Salary processed at next payroll; retro pay possible if approved. Include payroll request in submission.

Maya (CTO): We're updating IC rubrics to add concrete examples for "scope" vs "impact". Draft goes to the handbook Friday, will share a link here.

Sam K: Appeals flow? If I disagree with my manager's rating, what's next?

People Ops: Appeals open for 14 days after notification. Submit a short rationale to People Ops; we'll triage and follow SLA: 3 business days triage, decision within 10 business days (comp appeals up to 21).

Aisha L: PTO carryover?

People Ops: Carryover cap = 10 days. Exceptions require manager + People Ops sign-off. Parental leave unchanged (16/8 wks). Handbook: https://intranet.redwood.example/benefits

People Ops: We'll publish an FAQ summary tomorrow and host a follow-up office hours slot. Thanks for the questions! :clap:
